_note: Hand-curated project registry, same pattern as data/facilities/*.json (see scripts/seed_projects.py). case_numbers are the ONLY match key used by ai_pipeline/project_registry.py -- exact substring match against agenda item titles, never fuzzy/keyword matching. Both seeded here 2026-08-24 from real, verified eSCRIBE agenda + Action Summary data -- see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md, 'Week 3 -- City Hall Project Pages' for the source verification. New projects are added here by hand as real ones are identified; automatic entity creation from raw agenda text is deliberately not attempted (see that doc for why).

projects.title: Convenience Store, Fueling Station & Car Wash — Cactus Ave & Indian St
projects.description: A 5,000 sq ft convenience store, a fueling station with 10 dispensers, a drive-through car wash with 8 vacuum stalls, and a 7,000 sq ft retail building on a vacant lot at the southwest corner of Cactus Avenue and Indian Street.
projects.location_text: Southwest corner of Cactus Avenue and Indian Street, Moreno Valley, CA (APNs 482-272-052, -053, -054)

projects.title: Village Specific Plan 204 Amendment (Ordinance No. 1046)
projects.description: An amendment to the Village Specific Plan 204 (SP 204), a District 1 land-use plan, adopted by the City Council as Ordinance No. 1046.

projects.title: Aquabella Specific Plan — Vesting Tentative Tract Map No. 39549
projects.description: Vesting Tentative Tract Map No. 39549 for Planning Area 1 of the Aquabella Specific Plan (SP 218) -- the subdivision of 40.17 acres into 293 condominium units, including 22 lettered lots for streets, driveways, landscape, and a 2.68-acre park.
projects.location_text: North of Cactus Avenue, south of Brodiaea Avenue, east of Lasselle Street, District 3, Moreno Valley, CA

projects.title: Self-Storage Facility — Indian Street & Alessandro Boulevard
projects.description: A Conditional Use Permit for a 130,764 square-foot public self-storage facility on an approximately 3-acre vacant parcel, located east of Indian Street and north of Alessandro Boulevard (APN: 482-190-022). The Planning Commission's action to not approve the project was appealed to the City Council.
projects.location_text: East of Indian Street, north of Alessandro Boulevard, District 3, Moreno Valley, CA (APN 482-190-022)

projects.title: Edgemont Commerce Center — Change of Zone & Light Industrial Plot Plan
projects.description: Change of Zone (PEN23-0076) from Business Park to Light Industrial, Plot Plan (PEN23-0074) for a 142,797 square-foot light industrial building, Tentative Parcel Map (PEN23-0075) to consolidate parcels, and an Environmental Impact Report (PEN23-0077) -- on an approximately 7.7-acre vacant site at the southwest corner of Bay Avenue and Day Street.
projects.location_text: Southwest corner of Bay Avenue and Day Street, Moreno Valley, CA

projects.title: Brodiaea Residential Development — 134-Lot Subdivision
projects.description: General Plan Amendment (PEN25-0011), Change of Zone (PEN25-0012), Vesting Tentative Tract Map 39162 (PEN25-0010), and a Conditional Use Permit for a Planned Unit Development (PEN25-0014) -- the development of 134 single family residential lots on a vacant 14.4-acre site, located on the north side of Brodiaea Avenue and east of Moreno Beach Drive.
projects.location_text: North side of Brodiaea Avenue, east of Moreno Beach Drive, Moreno Valley, CA (APNs 478-070-013, -014, -015, 478-080-003, -004, -005)
